description: FY70 A-7D-8-CV block; c/n D-142; the South Dakota ANG 175th Fighter Squadron flew the A-7D from Sioux Falls 1977-1991 and several were dispersed to state sites; Aerial Visuals fix 44.363997 -100.352392 on the museum lawn
